name.description: A dotted lower-case name from an open vocabulary. Names beginning with aaf. are defined by the specification

subjectRef.description: Typed reference to an object. subjectKey = keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256(kind), chainId, namespace, id))

label.description: Human-readable note; not part of the reference

subjects.description: Which objects a rule is about and what a result attaches to

bindsTo.description: identity: the object itself. controller: whoever controlled it when the result was established. instance: one running instance. version: one version of code, model or configuration

onChange.description: What a change of the bound thing does to an established result

observation.description: The time a piece of evidence speaks about

kind.description: snapshot: the state at one block or instant. interval: what happened within a window. current: the state when the request is made

at.description: snapshot: block number or RFC 3339 time

window.description: interval: length in seconds, counted back from the request

evidenceRule.description: One dimension a rule looks at, and how

proposition.description: What has to be true, in words

source.description: Who or what the evidence must come from

freshness.description: Largest accepted age of the evidence in seconds

revocation.description: Whether and where revocation is checked at each use

onMissing.description: Result when the requester does not present what the rule asks it to present

onUnavailable.description: Result when a source cannot be read. A source that cannot be read is never a finding about the subject

disclosure.description: What the requester has to reveal

evidenceItem.description: One piece of evidence behind an entry or a result

subject.description: The object the evidence is about, where it is not the subject of the entry or request

reference.description: Where the evidence is: a transaction, a record identifier, a URI
